title: Uwuhamagara avuye mu mazi maremare
intro: Ibaze umutima wajejwe ubutumwa buva ku Mana, yamara, mu kanya nk’ako gukubita urugohe, ukava mu bantu babo ata ruhusha rutomoye. Uwo rugendo rwabashikanye mu kigeragezo kidasanzwe, ikigeragezo gikomeye co kwihangana no kwizigira Isumba vyose. Uwo muntu inkuru yiwe itwigisha ivy’ukwihana n’ubunini bw’imbabazi za Allah ni nde?
clues: Narungitswe mw’ihanga rikomeye, ariko ukwanka kwabo kwa mbere kwatumye ngira umubabaro.
Navuye mu bantu banje, nizera ko ubutumwa bwanje bwarangiye, imbere y’uko ndonka itegeko ritomoye ryo kugenda.
Narondeye inzira yo guca mu bwato, mugabo igihuhusi gikomeye be n’ugutora ubupfindo vyatumye ngira ibintu bikomeye cane.
Naraterewe mu kiyaga, ikiremwa gikomeye co mu mazi kirammira rwose.
Mu mwijima w’inda yayo, nahamagaye Allah, nemera ikibi nakoze, nshaka imbabazi ziwe.
Allah yategetse ico gikoko kunjugunya ku nkombe, nanje ndasubira kugira amagara meza munsi y’igiterwa kidasanzwe.
verse: Then the fish swallowed him, while he was blameworthy. (37:142)
